title: What is covered under warranty?
question: What is covered under warranty?
answer: Our warranty covers manufacturing defects in materials and workmanship under normal use conditions.

title: How long is the warranty?
question: How long is the warranty?
answer: Most footwear includes a 1-year limited warranty from the date of purchase.

title: How do I claim warranty?
question: How do I claim warranty?
answer: Submit a warranty claim through your account with photos of the defect and your order number.

title: Does warranty cover normal wear and tear?
question: Does warranty cover normal wear and tear?
answer: No, warranty only covers manufacturing defects, not damage from normal use or misuse.

title: Is the warranty transferable if I bought shoes secondhand?
question: Is the warranty transferable if I bought shoes secondhand?
answer: No, warranty coverage applies only to the original purchaser with valid proof of purchase.

title: What voids my shoe warranty?
question: What voids my shoe warranty?
answer: Warranty is voided by unauthorized repairs, improper care, or damage from accidents or misuse.

title: Does warranty cover sole separation?
question: Does warranty cover sole separation?
answer: Yes, sole separation due to a manufacturing defect within the warranty period is covered.

title: Can I get a replacement instead of a repair?
question: Can I get a replacement instead of a repair?
answer: Depending on the defect, we may offer a repair, replacement, or refund at our discretion.

title: How do I know if my shoe issue is a defect or normal wear?
question: How do I know if my shoe issue is a defect or normal wear?
answer: Our support team reviews submitted photos to determine if the issue qualifies as a manufacturing defect.

title: Does the warranty cover color fading?
question: Does the warranty cover color fading?
answer: Minor color fading from normal use is not covered, but significant discoloration from a material defect may be.

title: What documentation do I need for a warranty claim?
question: What documentation do I need for a warranty claim?
answer: You'll need your order number or proof of purchase along with clear photos of the defect.

title: How long does a warranty claim take to process?
question: How long does a warranty claim take to process?
answer: Warranty claims are typically reviewed and resolved within 7–10 business days.

title: Are limited edition releases covered under the same warranty?
question: Are limited edition releases covered under the same warranty?
answer: Yes, all footwear purchased through official channels carries the same standard warranty terms.

title: Does warranty cover shoes purchased from third-party retailers?
question: Does warranty cover shoes purchased from third-party retailers?
answer: Warranty coverage may vary for third-party purchases; we recommend contacting the retailer directly for those claims.

title: Can warranty claims be made in-store?
question: Can warranty claims be made in-store?
answer: Yes, warranty claims can be submitted either online or at any physical store location.
